Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Apple Watch Series 11.

What's new in Apple Watch Series 11?

+

Series 11 features a thinner design, largest display ever, faster charging (0-80% in 45 minutes), new S11 chip, and improved health sensors including skin temperature tracking.

How long does the battery last?

+

Apple Watch Series 11 offers up to 18 hours of battery life on a single charge. With optimized settings, you can extend this to 36 hours in Low Power Mode.

Is Apple Watch Series 11 waterproof?

+

Apple Watch Series 11 is swim-proof with water resistance up to 50 meters. It's perfect for swimming, surfing, or playing in the ocean.

What sizes are available?

+

Series 11 comes in two sizes: 42mm and 46mm case sizes, both featuring the largest and most advanced Always-On Retina displays.

Do I need an iPhone to use Apple Watch?

+

Yes, Apple Watch requires an iPhone XS or later with iOS 18 or later for setup and full functionality.

What's included in the box?

+

Each Apple Watch Series 11 comes with the watch, a Sport Band (S/M and M/L sizes), a 1m magnetic fast charger to USB-C cable, and documentation.
